ApplyCoordinationWithCode.description_en: Initiates a collaboration connection by using a collaboration code and obtains the collaboration connection credentials
ApplyCoordinationWithCode.description_zh: 使用协同码发起协同连接，获取协同连接凭证

EndAllCoordinationByOwner.description_en: Ends all collaboration tasks for the current resource and synchronously invalidates the collaboration code
EndAllCoordinationByOwner.description_zh: 资源所有者主动结束当前资源的所有协同任务，同步失效协同码

GenerateCoordinationCode.description_en: Generates a collaboration code for the current account and the connected cloud desktop. You can share the collaboration code with other accounts to allow them to connect to the cloud desktop
GenerateCoordinationCode.description_zh: 为当前账号和连接中的云电脑生成一个协同码，通过将协同码分享给其他账号，可以让其他账号连接到当前云电脑
